protocol: PATCH-SDF geometry probes (2026-10-08, #sec-nb-patch-sdf-prereg): the built-in query geometry functions alone on the first 12 AirfRANS full_test cases (100,000 interior queries each, float32), native boundary (~1,000 segments) against the 400-segment uniform-law coarsening (airfrans_volume_2d_sub400u, the same queries), and against a rigid motion of the native case (an in-plane rotation and a translation of one length unit). Bands by chord position (le_upstream x<0.1, mid, te_wake x>0.9) and by stored wall distance (wall <1e-6, near <0.01, te_near = near & x>0.9, far). Metrics per band: coarsening RMS change of d (all, same-sign only), sign-flip fractions (all; 'big' = |d_native| > 1e-3 chord), RMS log ratio, RMS (1 - cos) of the direction change, fractions turned > 25 deg and reversed; native accuracy against the stored signed distance (RMS log ratio, median ratio, sign agreement); posed change. Scripts kernel/char/pose_probe/pose_probe5..9.py on LHR; per-case records in <run>/summary.json there.

run5.description: side from a two-sided kernel vote with the squared-cosine facing (vote_sq), against the trained one-sided plane kernel (plane_pos), the two-sided kernel (smooth_sq) and the nearest form; LHR job 123275

run6.description: finite-patch forms, first design: HT measure radius with an absolute tie window of one radius (patch_ht_abs; _nbar = vote-weighted mean normal), the second-neighbour spacing window (patch_ht_d2), neighbour-floored radii (patch_nn_d2); LHR job 124807

run7.description: finite-patch form with the local / winding-number side (patch, reach 1 radius beyond the rim; patch_c2 reach 2), direction = gradient of the signed distance; LHR job 124953

run8.description: run7 with the direction = patch normal in the local regime; LHR job 124964

run9.description: the library form (geometry.patch_boundary_geometry, psharpe/isla c8414e583): local = nearest point interior to its patch or distance within one radius, else the exact winding number; LHR job 124969
